messages.text:
The browser smoke check exposed the real remaining issue: `src/server/queries.ts` imported the Node-backed DB module at top level, so Vite tried to evaluate `node:path` in the client during dev.

I’m moving that import behind the server/query call boundary and tightening the smoke test selectors so the test validates the app rather than matching “Research” as “Search.”
